description: UNIQUE EXPERIENCE IN PARIS. ♥️✨Welcome to your authentic Parisian apartment near Palais Royal – a bright, stylish, and spacious 2-bedroom retreat with exposed stone walls, soft light, and peaceful vibes.This super central apartment will make your stay become unforgettable.Ideally located near Louvre museum (300m), Palais Royal, la Comédie Française, Tullerie garden, Place Vendôme etc… and entirely renovated in February 2022, the apartment still keeps the old charm of ParisThe spaceThis apartment comfortably hosts up to 6 guests and is designed for those who want to stay in the heart of Paris while enjoying charm, space, and calm.Apartment is located on the ground floor. Access from the courtyard of building which has been surrounded by the greenery.- 2 BDR. Each bedroom has 2 beds: queen size bed & single bed- 2 queen size beds: 160cm x 200cm- 2 single beds: 90cm x 200cm- Convertible sofa bed in the living room, with real comfortable mattress 140cm x 200cm- Portable crib for baby- 2 shower rooms and 2 WC.- Well equipped kitchen: ustensils, oven, micro wave, kettle, Nespresso coffee maker, toaster etc...The apartment is located in the quiet building with other co-owners. If you decide to book our apartment, please respect the house rules correctly. The apartment is not convenient for the big party and any noisy event in the evening.Guest accessMetro line 1 & 7: Palais Royal Musée du LouvreMetro line 14: PyramideMetro line 3,7, 8, RER A: Opera (you should walk around 7min from this station)Bus 21, 27, 67Registration details7510106217362
